parts.note: having a hand in something is having agency in it
to set something up is to install it

explanation.surface: A firm is hired to fit a phone on someone's desk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Agency' looks like a business but stands for the part someone plays, a hand in it.
explanation.definitionFit: The handpiece of a landline is the part you lift, and by extension the whole instrument on a desk.

clue.text: Spring-term merriment does not include it

indicators.note: the word for merriment leaves out the following word

parts.note: hilarity is merriment

explanation.surface: The spring semester lacks any fun.
explanation.walkthrough: This is the name of the spring term at Oxford and of law sittings in England.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of the university and legal term beginning in January.

clue.text: Old capital that launched the five big banks?

definitions.text: Old capital that launched the five big banks?

parts.words: Old capital that launched the five big banks?
parts.note: capital suggests money behind major banks, but means an ancient city, whose name seems to start with nine and a Roman five

explanation.surface: Seed money once started the major high-street banks.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'Big Five' were Britain's leading clearing banks; the city was the Assyrian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Assyrian capital on the Tigris.

parts.note: sounds like a lone child abroad, but describes a one-hand cutting tool used across a flower bed

explanation.surface: A child crosses a frontier alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Garden pruning shears, worked with one hand, snip plants in a flower bed.
The word means see-through like fine fabric, frank in manner, and obvious to everyone.

definitions.meaning: a short prayer read at one point in a church service

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to gather or fetch, and a brief set prayer forming part of a church liturgy.

definitions.meaning: CO is a commanding officer, so belonging to him

explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to the commanding officer, and a crisp long-leaved lettuce.

indicators.note: the letters of the name are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A man called Ellis requests some cotton.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine smooth twisted cotton yarn, used for stockings.

clue.text: Openers of fairs near Diyarbakir said to have title

indicators.note: the letters are spoken, so each is written out as the name of the letter

parts.note: the openers are the first letters of fairs, near and Diyarbakir, spoken as the letter names eff, en and dee

explanation.surface: Opening ceremonies of markets near a Turkish city are reported as having a dignitary.
explanation.walkthrough: Diyarbakir is a city in Turkey; 'Openers of' takes the first letters F, N and D, and 'said' turns them into their spoken names.
explanation.definitionFit: A Turkish honorific for a man of standing, like 'sir'.

parts.note: a reorder of the letters p-tray gives the second half of the phrase, and trays and ordering tea feature at such a gathering

explanation.surface: A social occasion where a tray is called for.
explanation.definitionFit: An afternoon social gathering where refreshments come on trays.

parts.note: reads like cricket fielding positions (deep, extra cover) facing deliveries, but means lengthy outer garments worn as extra covering, say by postmen on their rounds

explanation.surface: A cricket captain sets fielders deep at extra cover for certain balls.
explanation.walkthrough: Deep and extra cover are cricket fielding positions and a delivery is a ball bowled; here deep means lengthy and covers are clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Lengthy overgarments are extra covering, worn for example by people delivering post in bad weather.

clue.text: Capital I found in upholstered seat

indicators.note: the letter is discovered sitting inside the word for the seat

parts.note: a sofa is a padded, upholstered seat

explanation.surface: Someone discovers a capital letter I lodged in a padded settee.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bulgarian capital city.

definitions.meaning: to fasten pieces with a metal pin
to secure or fix firmly, as a bolt is clinched

explanation.definitionFit: A metal pin fastens plates together, and fastening firmly is clinching; both senses are fixing.

clue.text: There can be some itching as these terms end

definitions.text: There can be some itching as these terms end

parts.words: There can be some itching as these terms end
parts.note: alludes to the proverbial itch felt by married couples once a span of seven years runs out

explanation.surface: Something irritating crops up when certain periods finish.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'seven-year itch' is the supposed restlessness in a marriage after seven years.
explanation.definitionFit: Periods of seven years each, the Latin plural form.

parts.note: proceeding means going forward

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word sum

explanation.surface: A loan amount that is growing is used to start a company.
explanation.definitionFit: The things done in a meeting, its business or transactions.

clue.text: The moral is — gout can be treated, he asserts

definitions.text: The moral is — gout can be treated, he asserts

indicators.note: treating the letters as a patient to be worked on rearranges them into a new form

explanation.surface: A doctor's lesson is that gout is curable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be treated' rearranges THE MORAL IS GOUT; the whole clue is also what a joint specialist would say.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor specialising in joint disorders, gout among them, would assert that it is curable.

clue.text: Spend too long at the bar on coach, perhaps

definitions.text: Spend too long at the bar

parts.note: on can mean over or about, as in a book on a subject
a coach is one kind of train carriage, so a train

explanation.surface: Someone drinks for too long at the pub before getting on a bus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at the bar' suggests drinking; here it is exercise at a barre or gym bar.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise to excess, harming fitness.

clue.text: Navicular foot-bone to be treated in dock?

definitions.text: Navicular foot-bone to be treated in dock?

parts.words: Navicular foot-bone to be treated in dock?
parts.note: navicular means boat-shaped, so a boat-shaped bone might be repaired in a dock like a ship

explanation.surface: A small bone in the foot needs hospital treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat-shaped bone in the wrist or foot, from the Greek for boat.

clue.text: Put out testimonial that can be double-checked

parts.note: to be put out is to be annoyed or angry
a reference is a written testimonial of character

explanation.surface: Someone issues a character reference whose claims can be verified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put out' looks like publishing but means annoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: A note sending the reader to another place in a text lets a point be checked twice.

parts.note: sounds like a school class problem, but refers to the build of a famously fat schoolboy

explanation.surface: A schoolboy is having difficulties in his class.
explanation.walkthrough: Billy Bunter is a greedy, overweight schoolboy of British comic stories; 'form' is also a school class.
explanation.definitionFit: The condition of being very overweight, Bunter's figure.

clue.text: Staff of bishop's office more cheerful after church opening

indicators.note: the word for more cheerful follows the letter
the first letter of the word church

parts.note: rosier means more cheerful or optimistic

explanation.surface: A diocesan employee becomes happier once the cathedral opens.
explanation.definitionFit: A hooked staff carried by a bishop as a symbol of pastoral office.

parts.note: going up
keep is maintenance, as in earning one's keep

explanation.surface: Money spent on looking after things keeps going up.
explanation.definitionFit: The expense of maintaining a property, its running costs.

parts.note: describes a clothes fastener made of two halves that snap together, not someone who pops

explanation.surface: Someone who pops something has two charming qualities.
explanation.definitionFit: A snap fastener has a male and a female half which engage with each other when pushed.
The surname of the American author Gertrude, and a large earthenware beer mug.

indicators.note: the letters are taken from within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A one-time village to the south of Orpington, a town in Kent.
explanation.walkthrough: Orpington is a town on the south-east edge of London.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for a small village, surviving in place names.

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, hence O

indicators.note: backwards, so the word for bad is read in reverse

parts.note: evil means bad

explanation.surface: A sweetheart is suffering from a bad back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lady-love' reads as one word, a sweetheart, but splits into the definition and the letter for love; 'back' reverses the word for bad.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name, so a woman can be called this.

clue.text: Flowing from a NE Baltic resort

indicators.note: read as re-sort, the letters are sorted again into a new order

explanation.surface: Something originating at a seaside town in the north-east Baltic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday town but means sort again.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning in a smooth singing style.

clue.text: Something for potting in London gardens, we hear

indicators.note: the word is said aloud to give another spelling

parts.note: Kew Gardens are the royal botanic gardens in London

explanation.surface: Gardeners in London need something to put plants into pots.
explanation.walkthrough: Potting means sinking balls in snooker or pool, not planting.
explanation.definitionFit: The stick used to strike balls into pockets in snooker.

clue.text: Senior lady longing to be finished outside

indicators.note: the word for finished goes around the word for longing
this word is a container marker: it says one piece is placed inside the other, and the clue words of the pieces show which way round

parts.note: done means finished
a yen is a longing

explanation.surface: An older woman wants her yearning to end.
explanation.definitionFit: The most senior woman member of a group.

parts.note: a tanner sounds like a leather worker or the old sixpence, but is a sunbather in a sheltered sunny spot

explanation.surface: Somewhere a leather worker might take refuge.
explanation.walkthrough: A tanner was also British slang for a sixpence coin.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheltered spot that catches the sunshine, ideal for sunbathing.
